title: Minigame: D5.34 Stun

source.basis: Manufactured under R0.3 as the minigame of the D5.34 claim (the Rules-first plan, section 7): German AFV, one CE, one under Stun +1, one concealed, attacked by a Russian squad with a MG and a Sniper, their facts entered by hand.
source.legacy: None: a manufactured minigame (R0.3), adapting no legacy card
adaptation: A minimal card (ruling R22.3): what a result does to an AFV crew, and where the Stun +1 applies, asked on the Rule Workbench.

introduction: D5.34's Stun: a Russian squad's MG and Sniper attack German AFV, one CE, one under Stun +1, and one concealed.

victoryConditions.text: A minigame has no victory: it proves its rules on the Rule Workbench and in play.
